transactions.desc: The Blue Jays outrighted Estrada to Triple-A Buffalo on Monday.
Fernandez was recalled from Triple-A Reno ahead of Monday's game against the Red Sox.
The Royals designated Marte for assignment Monday.
The Royals optioned Cuas to Triple-A Omaha on Monday.
The Royals optioned Rojas to Triple-A Omaha on Monday.
The Royals recalled Thomas from Triple-A Omaha on Monday.
The Diamondbacks optioned Locklear to Triple-A Reno on Monday.
The Diamondbacks optioned Carrillo to Triple-A Reno on Monday.
The Cubs optioned Triantos to Triple-A Iowa on Monday, Taylor McGregor of Marquee Sports Network reports.
The Cubs selected Miller's contract from Triple-A Iowa on Monday, Taylor McGregor of Marquee Sports Network reports.
The Cubs recalled Alcantara from Triple-A Iowa on Monday, Taylor McGregor of Marquee Sports Network reports.
The Reds recalled Maxwell from Triple-A Louisville on Monday.
The Reds designated Emanuel for assignment Monday.
The Cubs recalled Assad from Triple-A Iowa on Monday, Taylor McGregor of Marquee Sports Network reports.
The Rockies designated Lorenzen for assignment Monday.
The Rockies recalled Shook from Triple-A Albuquerque on Monday.
The Diamondbacks reinstated Martinez (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Monday.
The Diamondbacks reinstated Lawlar (hamstring) from the 10-day injured list Monday.
The Royals reinstated Garcia (hand) from the 10-day injured list Monday. He'll start at third base and bat cleanup in the team's series opener versus the Athletics.
The Royals reinstated Pasquantino (wrist) from the 10-day injured list Monday. He'll start at first base and bat fifth in the team's series opener versus the Athletics.
The Red Sox selected Olds's contract from Triple-A Worcester on Monday.
The Red Sox optioned Burgos to Triple-A Worcester on Monday.
The Pirates optioned Barco to Triple-A Indianapolis on Monday, Kevin Gorman of TribLive.com reports.
The Pirates reinstated Ramirez (personal) from the paternity leave list Monday, Kevin Gorman of TribLive.com reports.
The Pirates optioned Simon to Triple-A Indianapolis on Monday, Kevin Gorman of TribLive.com reports.
The Pirates reinstated Cruz (hand) from the 60-day injured list Monday, Danny Demilio of PittsburghBaseballNow.com reports.
The Mets selected Morel's contract from Triple-A Syracuse on Monday.
The Mets designated Arias for assignment Monday.
Morgan elected free agency Sunday.
The Rays optioned Boyle to Triple-A Durham on Monday.
